verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas supports natural-language operation only indirectly. Its official Editor MCP Server lets an external AI assistant modify project data in an open Editor session and verify the result in the viewport or a running app, and new projects ship PlayCanvas Skills for compatible AI coding agents. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language interface, so users must bring their own MCP-capable assistant, and the server is still pre-1.0 (0.7.1). Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven editing quality, a stable 1.0 MCP server.
